description: This Java class implements a Spring-based service handler for committing interoperation transfer commands within the Fineract platform. It handles command processing by invoking the InteropService's commitTransfer method.

classes.name: CommitInteropTransferHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles transfer commit commands via the processCommand method, interacting with the InteropService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to commit an interoperation transfer by delegating to the InteropService's commitTransfer method.
